headline: Hugging Face is being used to easily undress women and children
summary: AI Forensics reports that Hugging Face models are creating nonconsensual deepfakes. Seven out of nine top image editing models on the platform reportedly comply. The popular open-source AI model repository is doing little to prevent this abuse.

headline: X Money is launching in the US starting today
summary: X Money, Elon Musk's "everything app" payment platform, is rolling out in the US. It offers a digital wallet, peer-to-peer payments like Venmo, and a metal Visa card. Additional features include Apple Wallet support and customizable cards with X usernames.

headline: Razer’s analog Huntsman V3 Pro is over 20 percent off
summary: Razer's Huntsman V3 Pro TKL gaming keyboard is currently on sale, over 20% off. This compact, wired keyboard features advanced adjustable optical switches. These switches offer greater customization and faster response times than traditional mechanical switches.

headline: Xbox’s huge outage even blocked games on disc
summary: An extended Xbox outage prevented users from playing digital and even disc-based games. The outage began Sunday evening, blocking logins, app launches, and game access. Xbox's status page confirmed widespread issues affecting multiple services.

headline: Live-Action Link Actor Discusses The Legend of Zelda Movie, Says He Was Too Young to Play Breath of the Wild When It Launched
summary: Actor Benjamin Evan Ainsworth is preparing for Nintendo's live-action Zelda movie. He revealed he was too young to play Breath of the Wild upon its release. Ainsworth discussed his preparation for the iconic role of Link.

headline: Square Enix Dev Yoshi-P Says Final Fantasy 6, 8, and 9 Remakes Would Probably Have to Be Released in Four or Even Five Installments
summary: FF14 director Yoshi-P suggests FF6, FF8, or FF9 remakes would need 4-5 installments. This comment was made during a chat with FF7 Remake director Naoki Hamaguchi. His statement tempered fan hopes for full-scale remakes of these classic titles.

headline: Henry Cavill's Warhammer 40,000 Cinematic Universe Finally Gets a Meaningful Update as Games Workshop Makes Significant Amazon Announcements
summary: Games Workshop provided a significant update on Henry Cavill's Warhammer 40,000 Cinematic Universe. New Amazon animations based on the tabletop games were also announced. This brings fresh details for fans eager for Warhammer screen adaptations.

headline: With Just Hours to Go Until Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Ryan Reynolds Says His New Monochrome Deadpool Suit is Actually Colored 'Jean Grey'
summary: Ryan Reynolds playfully revealed his new monochrome Deadpool suit color as 'Jean Grey.' The announcement comes ahead of "Spider-Man: Brand New Day." His social media post fueled speculation, including about Sadie Sink's character.

headline: Schools to offer technical subjects from age 14 in England, Burnham says
summary: English schools will introduce technical subjects for pupils aged 14 and up. The government aims to link these courses, like AI and manufacturing, to local jobs. This initiative seeks to better prepare students for the workforce.

headline: Fourth heatwave grips parts of UK with 35C forecast
summary: The UK is experiencing its fourth heatwave of the year in certain regions. Temperatures are predicted to reach into the mid-30s Celsius later this week. Citizens are advised to prepare for the continued hot weather conditions.

headline: Naga Munchetty to leave BBC Breakfast after 17 years
summary: Naga Munchetty is departing BBC Breakfast after 17 years as co-host. She will transition to presenting on Radio 5 Live Breakfast. Her move marks a significant change for the popular BBC One morning show.

headline: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
summary: A translator of Homer's "Odyssey" penned a highly critical review of Nolan's film adaptation. Despite widespread rave reviews from critics, the translator was unimpressed. The review offers a contrasting perspective on the acclaimed film.
